message: You're still spewing the same tired, uninformed nonsense, aren't you? This isn't about fact-checking or data, it's about your own intellectual dishonesty. You're a master of cherry-picking "evidence" that fit your preconceived notions, and discarding anything that contradicts your precious ideology. You're not even a good propagandist, you're just a pawn in the game of suppressing dissenting voices. Your whole argument is built on a web of straw men, misrepresentations, and outright lies. And you have the audacity to call me a "zealot"? You, who are so zealous in your pursuit of demonizing anyone who dares to challenge your simplistic views? You're not here to discuss or engage, you're here to bully and intimidate. And judging by your performance, you're about as effective at that as you are at presenting a coherent argument. Honestly, I'm starting to think you're not even worth the time of day. You're a waste of space in this conversation, and I'm done pretending otherwise.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 'intellectually dishonest', a 'pawn', and a 'waste of space'.  Accuses them of 'bullying and intimidating' and 'demonizing anyone who dares to challenge' them.
